news.headline: DCTH shares hit new 12-month high above $17 after Q2 beat and target raises
news.summary: Stock climbed to a fresh 52-week high, extending momentum from the Q2 earnings beat and a wave of analyst price-target hikes.

news.headline: Delcath presents at Canaccord Genuity 46th Annual Growth Conference
news.summary: Management reinforced raised 2026 guidance and HEPZATO KIT commercial momentum to investors in Boston.

news.headline: H.C. Wainwright raises Delcath price target to $32, reiterates Buy
news.summary: Analyst lifted the target from $30 to $32 following the Q2 beat and raised full-year guidance.

news.headline: Delcath reports Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1M, raises full-year guidance to $104-108M
news.summary: Revenue up 20% YoY on ~30% HEPZATO volume growth; gross margin 90%, net income $2.7M, and plans to reach 37 active US treatment centers by year-end.

news.headline: Independent data at ESMO Breast Cancer 2026 show 60% hepatic response rate with PHP in metastatic breast cancer
news.summary: Retrospective analysis in heavily pretreated patients showed a 60% hepatic partial response rate with PHP-melphalan.

news.headline: Delcath doses first patient in Phase 2 DELUMA trial of HEPZATO in metastatic breast cancer
news.summary: First patient dosed at the European Institute of Oncology in Milan in the ~90-patient, 20+ site randomized trial of HEPZATO plus standard of care versus standard of care alone in liver-dominant HER2-negative metastatic breast cancer.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Will show whether raised full-year guidance ($104-108M) and center-activation pace remain on track.

catalysts.label: Additional HEPZATO treatment center activations
catalysts.detail: 31 active US centers as of Q2 2026; guided to ~37 by year-end 2026.

catalysts.label: DELUMA Phase 2 trial readout (liver-dominant metastatic breast cancer)
catalysts.detail: Randomized ~90-patient trial of HEPZATO plus standard of care vs. standard of care alone; first patient dosed July 2026.

catalysts.label: Phase 2 mCRC trial primary endpoint (hPFS) readout
catalysts.detail: Randomized Phase 2 trial in liver-dominant metastatic colorectal cancer.

pulse: Delcath is riding a strong momentum wave: Q2 2026 revenue of $29.1M (+20% YoY) beat expectations, full-year guidance was raised to $104-108M, and shares hit fresh 52-week highs above $17 with multiple analyst target hikes (H.C. Wainwright to $32). The pipeline is expanding beyond the core liver-cancer indication, with the DELUMA Phase 2 trial in metastatic breast cancer now dosing patients alongside the ongoing mCRC Phase 2 study and continued treatment-center rollout (31 active, targeting 37 by year-end). No major new company-specific catalysts have emerged since the mid-August highs; focus now shifts to sustained center activations and the Q3 2026 earnings report.
